origin: External expert answer to plan V2.0 Q4: a given delta-NLL carries very different economic weight depending on where in probability space the improvement sits, so delta-NLL alone cannot set a promotion threshold. This analysis supplies the missing half.
purpose: Measure where the comparator and challenger disagree relative to the production admission boundary, so that delta_promote can be set on evidence rather than by analogy to a 1X2 study.
explicitly_not: not a model comparison; it does not rank comparator against challenger
not an EV realisation study; no realised returns are used
not a market-relative study; no odds, no de-vig, no market probability
does not modify, reopen or reinterpret U2 or OOF_VAR_01

data_boundary.odds: NONE USED. The analysis is quote-free by construction; see metric definition.

models.challenger: the U2 out-of-fold challenger from OOF_VAR_01, so every fixture is scored by a model that did not fit on it
models.note: using OOF predictions avoids attributing in-sample overfit to decision impact

metric_definition.rationale: Production admits when cashflow_price_edge = d/F - 1 >= 0.05, i.e. when the quote d reaches 1.05 * F, where F is the model's fair decimal odds. Two models therefore give different admission decisions exactly for quotes in the band between 1.05*F_A and 1.05*F_B. The width of that band, relative to price, is the decision-relevant disagreement and needs no quote at all.
metric_definition.primary: relative fair-odds disagreement r = |F_challenger / F_comparator - 1| per fixture-line
metric_definition.interpretation: r >= 0.05 means the two models disagree by at least the whole width of the admission margin, so there exist realistic quotes at which one model admits and the other does not

stratification.purpose_of_region_split: directly tests the expert's point that a 90%->91% improvement and a 49%->52% improvement can carry the same NLL weight but very different decision weight

required: distribution of r overall and by stratum
share of fixture-lines with r >= 0.025 and r >= 0.10 as sensitivity
correlation between per-fixture-line NLL difference magnitude and r
share of total absolute NLL difference contributed by fixture-lines with r >= 0.05
forbidden: any claim that one model is better
any use of these numbers to alter MME, split, min_history, line grid or cohort

interpretation_rule.if_disagreement_concentrates_near_decisi: a given delta-NLL carries high decision weight; delta_promote may reasonably be set lower
interpretation_rule.if_disagreement_concentrates_in_extreme_: a given delta-NLL carries low decision weight; delta_promote must be set higher
interpretation_rule.in_all_cases: this analysis informs how delta_promote should be argued; it does not itself set delta_promote, which remains an economic judgement outside this document

known_limitation.no_executable_quotes: The expert's EV-sensitivity and economic-realisation layers need executable quotes bound to these fixtures. Gate 0B found zero overlap between team_xg_match fixtures and matchday_market_observations, so those layers cannot be run on this cohort. That gap is recorded, not worked around.
